category_specific_evidence: Issue #32987 reproducer test_enet_ols_consistency parametrized over precompute in [False, True] and effective_rank in [None, 10], with n_samples=300 and n_features=100, sample weights uniform in [0.01, 10]
PR #32845 states the CD solver does not converge for alpha=0 / l1_ratio=0 because the dual gap is not valid there; an alternative dual gap (formulation A, referencing #22836) is added
New dual_gap_formulation_A in _cd_fast.pyx computes primal and dual with scale = alpha / dual_norm_XtA when dual_norm_XtA > alpha, else scale = 1.0
Previously the test_enet_l1_ratio ConvergenceWarning filter was removed, and test_coordinate_descent.py is said to pass without warnings
Failing cases reported include test_enet_ols_consistency[42-10-False] and [59-None-True], with assertion se_enet <= se_ols <= 1e-20 showing values near 1e-26
reproduction_risks: Gram-matrix (precompute=True) path loses precision, so a reproduction may differ depending on precompute flag
Assertions compare values near 1e-20 and 1e-26, which are at floating-point noise level and depend on global_random_seed
Initialisation of coefficients and the iteration count at which behaviour diverges are not stated in the passages
Stopping criterion is the dual gap; for alpha=0 the standard dual gap is invalid and the alternative formulation A is used, which is only partially described
